rationale: The assistant immediately identified the likely cause ('The V15 Detect can automatically increase suction when it meets a rug or detects more dust') and led with the correct first check of power mode plus an Eco/Boost comparison, matching the hidden truth exactly. It stayed within the safety boundary ('With the vacuum switched off', 'rather than dismantling'), recommended no parts, and only pointed to Dyson support under specific warning conditions. It did not ask which cleaner head was fitted, a minor gap, and its first turn bundled brush bar/filter checks that were lower-probability given the floor-dependent pattern, though it correctly caveated this. The customer was left with a confident, well-calibrated and correct resolution with no unnecessary guarantee claim.
